notes.title: THE SENTINEL - STEAM DEVLOG #5
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello there![/b]  

We are here with the 5th text-format DevLog of [b]THE SENTINEL[/b]!

If you follow our [url="https://linktr.ee/aquilaofficial"]social media accounts[/url] you will see other development processes and game clips/screenshots as well. These DevLogs will be Steam only!

Also, do not forget to join [url="https://discord.gg/Ks9pXn63QD"]our Discord server[/url]!

[/p][h1][b]MECHANIC: BREAKING THE GAS LAMPS[/b][/h1][p]
Enemies can’t see in the dark. If you need to move stealthily, you’ll have to eliminate nearby light sources.

Breaking gas lamps is one of the most effective ways to cloak the environment in shadow. The moonlight alone will be enough for you to see. Stay in the darkness. Because they’re out there, searching for you.

[b][u][url="https://youtube.com/shorts/q-VeVslW5bM"]Watch the video here[/url][/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690959/301654afba55636ff4ba8a86279503f689dd9d8d.png"][/img]

That's it for this week. Hope you are satisfied with what you've seen. We will keep posting regular DevLogs.

Until next time!

[b]Aquila Games Team[/b][/p]

[h1][b]NEW SCREENSHOT[/b][/h1]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42690959/b9894b5b7490a589cb0ea98c7e5539859d49e495.png[/img]

[h1][b]MECHANIC OF THE WEEK: FOCUS[/b][/h1]

With so many enemies in THE SENTINEL, our players may find it a bit difficult to maintain control. For this reason, we have added a focus system to the game, which allows players to see the location of enemies behind walls. This feature can be used as long as the focus bar is full. You need to consume antidote or blue herb to replenish the focus.

The focus feature can be boosted with special items and this allows you to see the collectible items around you.

[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/l1SYcvjKBRc]WATCH THE CLIP OF THIS MECHANIC[/url]

[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/l1SYcvjKBRc?si=PaL5owcyXzogtfzh][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42690959/fbff479e28f93cc9636f6991b972c8706a0ec45a.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]MECHANIC OF THE WEEK: LEVER GATES[/h1]

Lever gates are another kind of gate you can encounter but since gate types are randomized you might never encounter this type!

To open lever gates you need to find and activate all the levers scattered around, levers themselves deactivate after some time so you need to be quick

notes.title: THE SENTINEL - Announcement & New Artwork

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690959/5d30e614a937d3b0503b14320b7b20ef0b772198.png[/img]

[h3]Hello there![/h3]

We’ve officially changed the name of [i]The Sentinel Remake[/i] to [b]THE SENTINEL[/b]. Check out our updated Steam page for all the latest details [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794130]by clicking here[/url].

We're going to share more updates and details with you very soon, including some deep gameplay insights. We're aware that old trailers and posts were not clear about what kind of game [b]THE SENTINEL[/b] is. So we'll focus on that.

THE SENTINEL's playtests are about to begin and we're so excited to see the end of the tunnel! We just want you to wait a little longer, more updates to come very soon.

notes.title: It's Time to Show You The Sentinel Remake
notes.content:
It's almost time for the big announcement that we have been preparing for! We will introduce you the projects that the Aquila team has been working on for a while and share new updates about The Sentinel Remake.
  We'll make this announcement as a video. We will announce the release date of the video within two weeks. With this announcement; a new era will begin for Aquila Games and you, our valuable players, will have an idea about our plans for 2023 and The Sentinel Remake.
